core.title: Modest Style Appliance Pull, First Impressions CFDPS

text.description_html:
First Impressions CFDPS Modest Refrigerator Door Pull

The simple design of this appliance pull makes it a very popular choice for dressing up freezers and refrigerators.

It is packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator / appliance door panel. Although this Appliance Pull is available in several lengths, a refrigerator needs to have an 18" or longer pull installed to effectively pull open todays large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the ones found on a Sub Zero refrigerator.

Specifications for First Impressions CFRBS Appliance Pull

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1.5"
  • Bracket Diameter: 15/16"
  • Pull Projection: 3"
  • Pull Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Material: High Quality Brass
  • Packaged with mounting screws for appliance panel

Note: This appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

* Sold individually.
